title: Department of Homeland Security: Phase 56I First-Pass Decision
publisher: Department of Homeland Security Office of Inspector General
summary: The DHS OIG report index checked on July 25, 2026 still exposes the FY 2024 enterprise information-security evaluation but does not list the selected FY 2025 enterprise evaluation. Phase 56I decision: No closure change. The dated catalog check preserves the exact missing-record boundary and does not treat project, financial-control, or component context as the annual enterprise result.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Released FY 2025 enterprise FISMA result.
Continuation rule: Reopen when DHS OIG publishes the final FY 2025 enterprise evaluation or a dated replacement outcome.
why_it_matters: The first-pass decision records whether a named official rail supplies the required denominator without converting adjacent or partial evidence into false closure.
ftfn_relevance: Completes the Phase 56I first-pass queue under a dated source check.
Keeps evidence state separate from performance, safety, quality, readiness, and value.
evidence_limits: A public report-index check cannot establish nonpublic work, final annual findings, implementation quality, incidents, recovery, or service effects.
Released FY 2025 FISMA evaluation, component findings, closure dates, endpoint and cloud coverage, incidents, recovery, and service effects.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
